name: CodeReview Sentinel
description: An AI-powered code review agent that analyzes pull requests for security vulnerabilities, performance anti-patterns, and style guideline violations across Python, TypeScript, and Go codebases. Integrates with GitHub and GitLab.

skills.name: Pull Request Security Audit
skills.description: Analyzes a pull request's diff for security vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, hardcoded secrets, and unsafe deserialization. Triggers on requests involving code review, security audit, or vulnerability scanning.
examples: Review this PR for security issues - https://github.com/org/repo/pull/142
Scan the diff in /path/to/diff.json for hardcoded secrets or SQL injection patterns
Does this code have any XSS vulnerabilities?

skills.name: Style Guide Compliance Check
skills.description: Checks code against organizational style guides (PEP 8, Airbnb TS, Uber Go). Reports violations with suggested fixes. Triggers on style review or lint requests.
examples: Check this file for PEP 8 compliance
Run the Airbnb TypeScript style guide check on src/components/

skills.name: Performance Pattern Analyzer
skills.description: Identifies performance anti-patterns in code diffs: N+1 queries, missing indexes, inefficient string concatenation, excessive allocations. Triggers on performance review requests.
examples: Is there an N+1 query problem in this diff?
Check for O(n²) patterns in the new algorithms
